"# System Design Document: HR Agentic Solution (MVP 1)

**Document Version:** 1.0.0  
**Status:** Approved / Ready for Implementation  
**Authors:** Principal Systems Architect & Principal Product Manager  
**Target Release:** MVP 1.0 (Q3 2026)

## 1. Executive Summary & Design Principles

The **HR Agentic Solution** is an enterprise-grade virtual assistant platform designed to automate Tier-1 HR/IT policy inquiries and execute self-service transactional workflows across **WorkWeek (HCM)** and **ServiceImmediately (ITSM/HRSD)**.

```mermaid
graph LR
    User([Employee]) --> UI[Web Chat UI]
    UI --> Gateway[API Gateway & Auth Proxy]
    Gateway --> Safety[Safety & Guardrails]
    Safety --> Orchestrator[Agent Orchestrator]
    Orchestrator --> RAG[(Policy Vector DB)]
    Orchestrator --> WW[WorkWeek Adapter]
    Orchestrator --> SI[ServiceImmediately Adapter]
    Orchestrator --> DLQ[(HR Ops DLQ)]
```

### Core Architectural Principles

1. **Zero-Trust Identity Assertion:** Even in the MVP 1 test-credential sandbox environment, all user turns are authenticated via an **API Gateway Mock Identity Assertion Layer** that injects a cryptographically signed JWT (`X-Authenticated-User`) to enforce strict Role-Based Access Control (RBAC).
2. **Deterministic State Mutation via Human-in-the-Loop (HITL):** The autonomous LLM is strictly prohibited from mutating external backend state without rendering an interactive **Confirmation Card** for explicit user review and authorization.
3. **Resilience & Forward SAGA Consistency:** Multi-system chained workflows avoid brittle two-phase rollbacks; instead, they preserve successful upstream state and route partial downstream failures to an **HR Operations Dead-Letter Queue (DLQ)** with transparent user notifications.
4. **Defense-in-Depth AI Safety:** Input guardrails, domain containment, closed-domain RAG retrieval gating, and NER-based SPII masking guarantee $\ge 99.5\%$ safety precision/recall and 0% ungrounded policy hallucinations.

--

"# System Design Document: HR Agentic Solution (GCP Architecture)

**Document Version:** 2.0.0 (Google Cloud Platform Edition)  
**Target Platform:** Google Cloud Platform (GCP)  
**Target LLM:** Google Gemini 1.5 Pro / Flash via Vertex AI  
**Authors:** Principal Systems Architect & Principal Product Manager

---

## 1. Executive Summary & GCP Architectural Principles

The **HR Agentic Solution** is an enterprise AI-driven virtual assistant deployed natively on **Google Cloud Platform (GCP)**. The platform orchestrates complex, multi-turn HR and IT self-service workflows across **WorkWeek (HCM)**, **ServiceImmediately (ITSM/HRSD)**, and internal policy repositories.

```mermaid
graph LR
    User([Employee]) --> LB[Cloud Load Balancing + Cloud Armor]
    LB --> Gateway[API Gateway / Cloud Run]
    Gateway --> Guard[Vertex Model Armor & Cloud DLP]
    Guard --> Orchestrator[Agent on Cloud Run / Vertex AI]
    Orchestrator --> Gemini[Gemini 1.5 on Vertex AI]
    Orchestrator --> VectorSearch[(Vertex AI Vector Search)]
    Orchestrator --> Adapters[Adapters on Cloud Run]
    Orchestrator --> DLQ[(Cloud Pub/Sub DLQ)]
```
